title: Rate
description: One purchasable service. Two prices are returned and they are not interchangeable: amount is the checkout total a customer pays, with the SMKlog fee inside it (the fee is itemized only on the checkout receipt), and retail_amount is the carrier’s own counter price for the same parcel where the carrier publishes one (0 where it does not).

service.description: Service display name, e.g. Ground Advantage

service_code.description: Carrier service code, stable across calls

amount.description: Checkout total, USD, SMKlog fee inside

retail_amount.description: Carrier retail counter price, USD; 0 when not published

delivery_days.description: Transit days the carrier quoted, null when it quoted none

delivery_window.description: e.g. "2-5 business days"; null when the carrier quoted none

delivery_estimated_date.description: ISO date the carrier estimates, null when it gives none
